MINI MINUTES: 403/P. Mahoney Clerk: O. Guandique Reporter:Maria Torreano, CSR #8600

Kyra Alexis Subbotin present with Plaintiff. Francis J. Ortman present with Defendant. The parties participate in a settlement conference and return with a full agreement. Parties are voir dired as to the terms of the agreement. The parties agreement is as follows: (1) Defendant shall pay the Plaintiff the amount of $135,000.00. 50% shall be paid (14) days from 9/11/09. 25% shall be paid (90) days from 9/25/09. 25% shall be paid (180) days from 9/25/09. Defendant shall pay a 10% late payment of the remaining amount due for any late payment; (2) There shall be an attorney's fees provision should the parties have to enforce the agreement in Court; (3) There shall be a non-harassment clause mutually agreeable included. There shall also be a mutual waiver and mutually agreeable confidentiality clause included as well as a release under Civil Code 1542 regarding known and unknown claims; (4) Michael Schlaee has given his authority to have this agreement entered on his behalf; (5) The Court reserves jurisdiction to resolve any issues in this matter; (6) In the event of a default the Plaintiff shall be entitled to come to Court and enforce the agreement as a judgment; (7) If the parties have any issues with the enforcement of this agreement they shall contact the clerk to set up a conference call with the Court; (8) The Court vacates the trial date set for 2/01/2010. Mr. Ortman to prepare order.
